connector.name: Email (IMAP/SMTP) by mindstone
connector.registryDescription: Email IMAP/SMTP MCP server: iCloud, Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook, and custom IMAP providers
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server-email-imap. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mindstone account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: EMAIL_IMAP_PROVIDER
env.description: Provider — icloud, gmail, yahoo, outlook, or custom (auto-detected from email domain if unset)

env.name: EMAIL_IMAP_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT
env.description: Set to 1 to opt into cleartext IMAP/SMTP (strongly discouraged)

env.name: EMAIL_IMAP_MAX_RECIPIENTS
env.description: Safety cap: maximum combined To+CC+BCC recipients per email_send call. Defaults to 25; raising bypasses spam-prevention guardrails against prompt-injection-driven mass sends.

env.name: EMAIL_IMAP_RATE_LIMIT_PER_HOUR
env.description: Safety cap: maximum email_send calls per rolling window. Defaults to 50; protects against runaway sends when injection content escapes the LLM's intent.

env.name: EMAIL_IMAP_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS
env.description: Sliding-window length for the rate limit (ms)
